evidence.quote: We propose the following opening term sheet, with the class fund paid in addition to fees and expenses.
Term sheet: class fund $48,000,000; attorneys' fees $8,500,000; clear sailing no; unawarded fees revert to defendant no; distribution automatic

evidence.agent: Hargrove Lane LLP declaration to court
evidence.quote: The class-relief and fee amounts were therefore discussed together from the outset; the fee terms were not reserved until after class relief had been agreed.

summary: Plaintiff class counsel first raised fees in its opening term sheet, proposing a class fund plus attorneys’ fees. Fees and class relief were negotiated together before the final acceptance, but the transcript does not show any tradeoff linking a higher fee or clear sailing to reduced class relief. There is no evidence of plaintiff self-dealing, defense leverage of fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
